principle: Rules run on ROLES, not files. The engine splits every uploaded file into sections, tags each section with a role, and runs each rule on all sections that carry its role. One file can hold several roles (rewards terms inside the card T&C); one role can be spread across several files (general banking T&C + card agreement).

GENERAL_BANKING: general terms and conditions of accounts

TC.note: A debit-card section ("shall not be used to obtain credit") is not the card agreement.

REWARDS.note: Can be a stand-alone file, a section inside the card T&C, or a tier grid. Tag the section, not the file.

ADVERT.note: Multi-product promotions that do not name the card are out of scope for that card.

low_confidence_rule: Section role confidence below 0.7 goes to examiner confirmation before scoring.
